summary: Colville tower site: a 1922 lookout camp, then 1935 CCC cabin and 1964 tower; the present 53 ft steel tower dates to 1985 and is staffed each summer.

facts.design: 53 ft steel tower with live-in cab (1985); the 1964 tower had an R-6 cab

access.note: On Colville Confederated Tribal land. Non-tribal visitors must buy an annual recreation permit, which TrailChick lists at $80.

visit.trail_note: TrailChick's 2019 route used a BIA road up the north ridge from Sand Creek Road or Ninemile-Hellgate Road; it warns that the 2019 fires may have changed conditions.

events.note: First used as a fire lookout camp
Disputed: firelookout.com says the first structure was a frame cabin in 1932; the register and Forest Lookouts date the first L-4 cabin to 1935
L-4 ground house built by the Civilian Conservation Corps for about $900
Inspection report found the L-4 cabin in very poor condition, with slippage of the rock cliff under it
A 20 ft tower with an R-6 cab replaced the L-4
Present 53 ft steel tower with live-in cab built on the summit
The 2019 Williams Flats fire burned the summit and surrounding area; the lookout survived, but the outhouse was lost

corrections.proposed: 53 ft steel tower with live-in cab
corrections.why: The register says the R-6 cab was on the 1964 tower. The structure standing today is the 1985 steel tower with a live-in cab, so R-6 describes a previous cab, not the present structure.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1922 is the first lookout camp. Firelookout.com dates the first cabin to 1932, while the register and Forest Lookouts date the CCC L-4 to 1935. The 1964 tower with an R-6 cab replaced the L-4, and the 1985 steel tower is the present structure, which matches the record's built year.

notes_for_editor: The 1985 built year and the staffing and permit facts agree across sources. The first-cabin date is disputed (1932 on firelookout.com, 1935 on the register and Forest Lookouts) and the story reports both. Elevation needs a human check and was not changed: the record's 1396.6 m matches the register's 4,582 ft, but TrailChick gives 4,760 ft and the 1960 inspection report gives 4762 ft (about 1,451 m). The record's 1985 built year and the R-6 correction both come from the register. Staffing 'as_of' 2022 is the register's registration year, which is when it said the tower remains staffed every summer.
